title: Infinite Scrolling Marquee
knob: Create a `.marquee` container with `overflow: hidden` and `white-space: nowrap`. Inside, add text like "Perm • 2 Days • SEO • Perm • 2 Days • SEO". Animate `translateX` from 0 to -50%.
